_doc: Per-script subtitle metrics. Scripts are not interchangeable: Devanagari stacks conjuncts above and below the line, Telugu stacks further still. A single line-height for all three clips the tall scripts, and the clip never shows up in the English cut.

hi.probe_note: These must render without clipping at the top or bottom of the line box. ra-repha rides above; the ya-phala and u-matra hang below.

te.probe_note: Telugu stacks the subscript consonant below the base and the vowel sign above. This is the script most likely to clip and the one least likely to be checked.

style.rule: No box, no plate, no drop shadow. Outline only, so the frame stays visible behind the line.
